stories.h: Trump threatens to bar three major newsrooms from the White House
stories.w: The announced bans target CNN, MS NOW and Politico over unfavorable coverage, raising a direct First Amendment dispute; the outlets' journalists remained on White House grounds Friday and implementation was still unclear.

stories.h: Every state applies to join Medicaid's international drug-pricing model
stories.w: All 50 states, Washington, D.C. and Puerto Rico applied, though only 40 states and Puerto Rico had signed participation agreements; the model could lower selected drug prices, but independent experts say savings remain uncertain.

stories.h: Canada accelerates an economic and security pivot toward Europe
stories.w: Prime Minister Mark Carney says Ottawa and Europe have launched a process for a new alliance after Canada suspended trade talks with Washington, marking a strategic effort to reduce dependence on the United States.

stories.h: Denmark and Greenland accept a larger US military presence without ceding sovereignty
stories.w: The emerging three-government agreement expands American security access while keeping Greenland within the Danish realm; it still requires parliamentary action in Denmark and Greenland before taking effect.

stories.h: Ukraine convenes a new eight-country Carpathian forum
stories.w: The inaugural summit brought Ukraine together with seven Central and Eastern European neighbors as peace talks stall, creating another regional channel for security, infrastructure and economic cooperation.

stories.h: Johannesburg's waste crisis exposes a fast-growing urban health risk
stories.w: More than 2,000 illegal dumping sites and a landfill system beyond capacity illustrate a continent-wide challenge as Africa's urban population heads toward 1.4 billion and uncontrolled disposal remains widespread.

stories.h: Bank of Japan raises rates to a 31-year high
stories.w: The central bank lifted its policy rate from 1% to 1.25% as it shifted from trying to create inflation toward preventing an overshoot, increasing borrowing costs across the world's fourth-largest economy.

stories.h: Australia proposes national rules for frontier AI and data centers
stories.w: A government consultation considers mandatory reporting of serious AI incidents, water and energy standards, and reserved computing capacity for domestic users; submissions remain open through October 9.

stories.h: Federal inquiry calls for national youth-detention standards
stories.w: A cross-party Senate inquiry found fragmented rules and severe Indigenous overrepresentation, with First Nations children making up 56% of those under youth-justice supervision despite being under 4% of the population.
